name: ROS2 Humble Devcontainer
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'cd /workspaces/autonomous_exploration_development_environment && [ -f ./src/vehicle_simulator/mesh/download_environments.sh ] && bash ./src/vehicle_simulator/mesh/download_environments.sh && echo "source /usr/share/gazebo/setup.sh" >> ~/.bashrc && echo "source /workspaces/autonomous_exploration_development_environment/install/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc && colcon build --symlink-install --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && source install/setup.bash'
